new_declaration:
theorem isComplete_map_iff [RingHomSurjective σ₁₂] {p : Submodule R E} :
    IsComplete (p.map f.toLinearMap : Set E₂) ↔ IsComplete (p : Set E) :=
  isComplete_image_iff f

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) (s : Set E) : IsComplete (g '' s) ↔ IsComplete s := by simp

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) (x : E) : ‖g x‖₊ = ‖x‖₊ := by
  simp only [SemilinearIsometryClass.nnnorm_map]

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) (x : E) : ‖g x‖ₑ = ‖x‖ₑ := by
  simp only [SemilinearIsometryClass.nnnorm_map, enorm]
